Factor and normalize that polynomial over the same field, using the already proved zero-power reduction. The full primitive eigenline theorem supplies all positive-index scalar identities on the constructed range. Reuse review found that the original integral Hecke basis already remains complex-linearly independent, with an exact complex basis and integral coordinates. This is the next faithful arithmetic-relation transport route; a separate whole-coefficient-field reality argument is unnecessary and deferred.
